newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Van Miert declines comment on Clabecq.
newsitem.headline: Van Miert declines comment on Clabecq.

text.p: European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert declined to comment on Thursday on a plan to salvage Forges de Clabecq and on a complaint filed by the UK Steel Association against the Belgian steelworks.
"We don't have any information yet, but it is strange that one should complain even before the file is ready," he told reporters in reply to a question.

Clabecq filed for bankruptcy after the European Commission banned the southern Belgian region of Wallonia in December from injecting 1.5 billion Belgian francs into the loss-making firm and ordered the company to reimburse subsidies already granted.
Clabecq has appealed the Commission's decision before the European Court of First Instance.
The Walloon region, Clabecq's largest shareholder, and Italian-Swiss firm Duferco agreed earlier this month on a partial takeover of the company, which must still be approved by the workers.
Belgian newspaper Le Soir recently quoted the UK association as saying it was concerned that the illegal aid would not be re-paid and that more subsidies would follow.
